name: zk-flow
description: zkFlow is a website where you can track your address and see how many volume you did on different zkSync protocol

paragraphs: zkFlow is an innovative tool designed for tracking addresses and analyzing transaction volumes on various protocols. This solution aids users in efficiently managing their blockchain activities, offering a clear and detailed view of their transactions.
features: Address Tracking: Easily track your addresses.
Volume Analysis: Gain detailed insights into your transaction volumes across different protocols.
Intuitive User Interface: Simple and easy-to-use interface, suitable for both beginners and experienced users.
Security and Privacy: Ensure the security and privacy of your data, NO DATA is not sent anywhere except to get the your transactions list.
